title: Trump Tower
visualBrief: The Fifth Avenue bronze-glass tower with its exact distinctive sawtooth shaft, five sequential planted lower terraces, dark horizontal bronze spandrels, gold storefront transoms and bronze entrance canopy.

nativeAxes.longitudinal: +X along the mapped building long axis
nativeAxes.origin: Ground-level center of exact-QID mapped footprint frame

reconstruction.plan: Separate202 m tower part159831418 and five successive mapped lower setback parts, anchored in exact-QID ground part265345374
reconstruction.facade: Bronze tinted glass with three-dimensional concave spandrel courses and modeled terrace planting

geographicProposal.notes: Exact mapped sawtooth shaft and all five lower setback parts preserve their signed frame relative to Fifth Avenue. Main shaft is not inferred from the20 m exact-QID ground part. Ground datumY0.

scaleBasis: Published owner/architect/contractor heights and distinguishing construction systems; map footprint for local orientation, with reconstructed details declared separately.
geometrySource: Original deterministic exterior geometry; no downloaded meshes or copied photographic textures. Footprint-derived registration includes separately attributed OpenStreetMap evidence.
sourceLicense: Original reconstruction under repository license. Map-derived plan evidence: © OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL-1.0. Reference publications are linked, not redistributed.
materialMethod: Canonical shared material graphs bound through molenSurface extras with metric coordinates divided by central repeat meters. Vertex colors provide component tint. Glass retains opaque metallic-roughness PBR; no bitmap texture copies per model.
reviewStatus: source-geometry; near/far and shared-material captures pending
limitations: Exterior geometry uses published overall dimensions and map evidence; panel subdivision, connection dimensions and local entrance details are reconstructed. Glazing uses opaque PBR with explicit geometry; no copied facade photograph is embedded.

Terrace planting and storefront bays are reconstructed. Building height202.4 m and58 physical stories follow CTBUH; the owner markets68 floors. Fine storefront signage and tenant interiors are omitted.
importReason: Preserve thin facade frames, panel joints and crown/antenna details until a measured LOD chain is authored.
